title: PILD: Physics-Informed Learning via Diffusion
summary: Diffusion models have emerged as powerful generative tools for modeling complex data distributions, yet their purely data-driven nature limits applicability in engineering and scientific problems where physical laws must be respected. This paper proposes Physics-Informed Learning via Diffusion (PILD), a framework that unifies diffusion modeling and physical constraints through a probabilistic residual formulation with a virtual residual observation sampled from a Laplace distribution.
